name: Awka

queries.query: Awka Nigeria official cadastral parcel map land registry Anambra GIS official
queries.result: First-party results identified the Anambra State Ministry of Lands as the local land custodian, its ANAMGIS state GIS/land-administration system, official online land services, and official Anambra land/property procedures. The public pages establish a local registry/GIS/procedure but do not expose an anonymous parcel map/API or safe parcel ID+geometry response.

queries.query: Awka Nigeria Igbo: Awka Anambra cadastral parcel map land registry official (Ala na Awka, ndebanye ala, maapụ kadastral)
queries.result: No distinct first-party Igbo-language cadastral viewer, API, or parcel download was found. The official English-language Anambra Ministry of Lands ANAMGIS and land-service pages are the available first-party evidence for Awka; no local-language source was used to infer parcel coverage.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Anambra State Ministry of Lands, headquartered in Awka; its official pages describe state land administration, registry/cadastral procedures, and ANAMGIS.
